scope: All 101 current example projects: 12 original and 89 generated
method: Inspected catalogue metadata, shared challenge generation, actual runtime family implementations, common progression, and each original main.js input/state structure. Independent assessment; no other judge report or prior polish scores consulted.
limitations: No child, educator or physical iPad playtest.
No fresh rendered browser playtest: browser IPC was unavailable in this session; these are source-grounded quality and duplication inferences.
The parent reports liking the first 5–6 games but does not identify them. No assumption about their identities.
High confidence refers to evident mechanical duplication, not proof that no child could enjoy the game.
Rework means withdraw/defer this version and preserve the concept only if a substantially better design is justified. Retain candidate is not unconditional release approval.

records.child_experience_risk: Source inference, not observed child boredom. Default five-step completion loop and adult-authored targets constrain agency; thematic art and correct-answer effects do not establish voluntary replay.
